headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron was killed in a shooting attack at a spring in Benjamin. The terrorist was captured in a hospital in Ramallah. The terrorist opened fire on people at a spring near Neve Tzuf, abandoned his vehicle, and fled on foot. Natanel Shkaron, a father of six from Eli Tzuf, died after being evacuated to the hospital. After an extensive manhunt, the terrorist was apprehended in a Ramallah hospital, injured by IDF tracker fire. A second terrorist who attempted a ramming attack in the northern Samaria region was later neutralized.
